[[Air Marshal]] '''Cargeloch''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Biography==
Cargeloch was responsible for both leading the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] wing assigned to the airspace around [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]] and instructing at the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] base on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The recruits there frequently joked that he slept in his uniform&mdash;their jocular frivolity belying recurrent nightmares of the Air Marshal crinkling the leather on his black flight gloves before slapping the recruits across the face for incompetence in the [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE]] simulators.<ref name="CatCW" />

Cargeloch earned his rank by blasting a rebellious city to rubble with only four [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]].<ref name="CatCW" />
